description: Daily US Gulf Coast kerosene-type jet fuel spot price (USD per gallon) from FRED (US EIA series DJFUELUSGULF): latest value and recent history. It is a US Gulf Coast benchmark, not a Jet-A1 or European refinery index. Choose this tool for: Daily US Gulf Coast kerosene-type jet fuel spot price. Close alternatives on this server: energy_natural_gas_henry_hub (Daily Henry Hub natural gas spot price in USD per MMBtu); logistics_port_call_schedule (Recorded daily port calls at one port by ship type). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
